question: By what means does the speaker claim to have come to know the determination of the Kaula doctrine in addressing the Lord of the Kaulas?
premises: The speaker addresses the Lord of the Kaulas.
The speaker claims to have come to know something.
That knowledge is attributed solely to the grace of the addressee.
The object known is the determination of the Kaula doctrine.
inference: It is by the addressee's grace alone that the speaker has come to know the Kaula determination.
uncertainties: The extent of that knowledge is not specified in this verse.
plain_english: By your grace, O Lord of the Kaulas, I have come to know the determination of the Kaula doctrine.
